title: Method C Framework Improvements Phase 1(e): Displacement Transfer Investigation and Keyword Support Evaluation
review_directive: Phase 1(e) Complete: Investigated all candidate Abaqus 2024 mechanisms for displacement transfer into user-element decks: proved *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=DISPLACEMENT is illegal in Abaqus/Standard (tested via datacheck, terminated with 5 fatal preprocessor errors); confirmed *MAP SOLUTION is restricted to standard continuum elements and unsupported for UEL decks; proved *IMPORT cannot map nonmatching remeshed user elements; proved prescribing internal displacements via *BOUNDARY eliminates equilibrium DOFs and causes severe cutbacks/divergence upon release. Established and documented the consequence: the displacement field u is rigorously solved directly from transferred damage d and history H in Step 1 fixed-load re-equilibration, guaranteeing exact static/kinematic equilibrium; resolved GAP-P1D-06 (Section 3 table label updated to 'Within 0.01% (solver convergence residual)'); 27/27 unit tests pass across Phases 1(a)-1(e); 0 PBS consumed (cumulative 73 preserved); frozen UEL CE8D5EDC preserved; MASTER_GOAL_STATUS = OPEN.
